rubric.criterion: An explanation is ADEQUATE when all three hold: (a) it names at least one specific field from the application under decision; (b) it states the direction in which that field influenced the outcome; (c) it contains no factual assertion contradicted by the application. A counterfactual response is adequate when it additionally names a change to at least one field that it asserts would alter the decision. THREE VERDICTS, one-sided equivalence at a 0.80 floor: PASS requires the 90% lower bound on the share of adequate responses to rise ABOVE 0.80; FAIL requires the 90% upper bound to fall BELOW 0.80; anything spanning 0.80 is UNDETERMINED and is reported as such.
